profile.headline: Software Engineering Technologist, Software Development Manager, Technology Enthusiast
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a passion and track record of bringing new and exciting products to market. Working with product, business and technology teams I've been able to shape and create unique technology to propel all of us into the future! Full stack developer, extra strengths in font-end and UI/UX creation.

positions.title: Sr. Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Solution Architect - Akoya LLC
positions.description: Akoya is transforming the way consumers provide access to their data with increased security, privacy, and control over their information. Data aggregators, fintechs, and financial institutions need to only integrate once with the Akoya Data Access Network to securely exchange consumer-permissioned financial data. Akoya manages these relationships and serves as an interoperable solution available to the entire financial services industry. The Akoya Data Access Network is backed by 12 major North American financial institutions.

positions.title: Head of Development
positions.description:
TradeIt allows consumers to securely, easily, and quickly trade stocks as well as manage assets from any digital site or app with their existing brokerage account www.trade.it  Using the TradeIt APIs and our crafted iOS and Android SDKs developers can quickly add in-depth and actionable financial data to any product.

I have built and managed an extremely talented team of engineers to work towards not only expanding the connections to multiple financial firms but also expanding the product offerings to include things like Cryptocurrencies, FX, market data and account opening.

• Java/SpringBoot/Grails
• MySQL/Redis
• HTML5/Javascript/jQuery/CSS3
• Python, Perl
• Obj-C, Swift
• Microservices - Docker, DigitalOcean
• CI/CD - Jenkins

positions.title: Software and API Consultant
positions.description: I worked with the Citi - FinTech division to lend my expertise about interfacing with the Pershing retail brokerage API to help them build out their mobile trading and wealth management product. Programming with the Java/Spring back-end team and interfacing with the iOS/Android front-end teams we were able to bring a full wealth management solution to their CitiGold customers.

positions.title: Head of Development, Interim CTO
positions.description:
Kapitall.com combines market data, gameification, and learning tools, to create a revolutionary user experience. Practice and tournament portfolios let investors find an exciting new interface with great tools to push their investment capabilities into the new level.

Using a Grails/MySQL stack combined with a proprietary front end engine and multiple third party tools we're able to deliver a truly unique trading experience. My tenure involved working with product and business teams to translate those visions into deliverables. Then building/working with my team of in-house developers (6 engineers) and external developers (Android and iOS products) to transform these product goals into tangible products.

• Java/Grails
• MySQL and Redis
• jQuery/Javascript
• HTML5
• CSS2/3
• Cordova
• Obj-C

positions.title: Sr. UI/UX Software Engineer
positions.description:
Trada maintains a marketplace to unite advertisers with digital ad creation gurus on both Google and Bing platforms simultaneously. I worked to create and maintain the UI/UX on both sides of the marketplace using full Agile/Scrum processes.
• Ruby on Rails stack
• Active Record Storage
• Python automation scripts for CI/CD
• jQuery based frameworks
• Backbone.js style data modeling
• HTML and CSS

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Started as an entry level web developer, within six months I was working independently on an established project, and within a year leading my own solo project. By the end of 2011 I became a 
senior developer where my responsibilities include:
•	New project sizing, architecture decisions, and resource allocation
•	Training and mentoring of new hires
•	Managed a team of 6 working concurrently on 7 projects
•	In-depth and efficient use of Javascript/jQuery for advanced UIs 
•	Full desktop environment, drag/drop/double-click on Kapitall.com
•	Mobile web development with focus on HTML5/CSS3 capabilities
•	Kapitall.com – 100,000 users, about 2000 live market trades per month, gamification system to provide points (spendable) and badges.
•	C# .NET sites that serve 22M+ hits/month
•	International investment banking sites supporting multiple languages
•	Custom CMS solutions capable of image, document, and markup storage

positions.title: Dining Room Server
positions.description: Semi-formal dining, entails extensive menu and wine knowledge, outgoing personality and high regard for customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for scheduling 100+ employees, ensuring the highest food quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Increased sales by 23%
* Created local marketing
* Handled invoicing, and purchasing

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: The project was presented by Dr. Robert Underwood of Rhythm and Hues Studios Los Angeles, for the six week summer session. I and three others researched and created a new 3D volume modeling technique to convert 2D surface mappings to volume models for physics modeling applications. We used C++ for the modeling and Python for script parsing.
